# Third-party components

MayOS kernel and desktop sources in this project are original. The boot ISO uses GNU GRUB (GPLv3+); QEMU is an external development/runtime tool. They are not the MayOS kernel. GRUB source is available from https://www.gnu.org/software/grub/ and the corresponding Debian source package https://packages.debian.org/source/trixie/grub2 .

Embedded bitmap glyphs are generated from Noto Sans CJK (SIL Open Font License 1.1) and DejaVu Sans Mono. Their license notices are included here. The generated font is a limited bitmap subset, not the full upstream font family.
